sources.title: Draft London Plan consultation
sources.verified_claim: The Draft London Plan consultation is open from July to 15 October 2026 and the plan remains draft before examination and finalisation. It is not treated as adopted policy or as permission for any sample parcel.

sources.title: MD3515 London Plan – publication and statutory consultation
sources.verified_claim: MD3515 approved the Draft London Plan only for statutory consultation and records a timetable targeting formal publication in March 2028. Consultation approval is not adoption or a parcel-level planning outcome.

sources.title: Draft London Plan
sources.verified_claim: City Hall labels the 16 July 2026 document publication status as Draft. Policies and place visions are therefore recorded as emerging evidence and not silently substituted for the adopted development plan.

sources.title: London Plan Evidence
sources.verified_claim: The evidence page states the next London Plan evidence base is being updated and identifies multiple July 2026 studies. Evidence studies inform plan preparation but are not themselves adopted parcel policies or site permissions.

sources.title: Planning Inspector issues Local Plan letter after public hearings
sources.verified_claim: Enfield reports a post-hearing Inspector letter setting out further modifications or steps required for soundness and legal compliance. The plan remains in examination-stage process and is not treated as adopted or as confirming parcel_30762 allocation.

sources.title: Local Development Scheme
sources.verified_claim: Havering states its current Local Development Scheme was approved in April 2025 and covers 2025-2027. A plan-preparation timetable is process evidence and not a parcel_46142 planning permission or allocation.

sources.title: Notice of intention to commence Local Plan
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth gives notice of its intention to prepare Lambeth Local Plan 2029 and says preparation is expected to begin on 31 October 2026. The notice does not replace the current plan or allocate parcel_61522.

sources.title: Local Plan timetable
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's timetable places scoping consultation in September 2026, preparation gateway activity later in 2026-28 and adoption in April 2029. Future milestones are retained as timetable only, not current policy or parcel certainty.
